experiment_data.method_description: Mouse NIH3T3 cell lines stably expressing FLAG-tagged wild-type DJ-1 or its mutants (M26I, R98Q, D149A, L166P, C106S) were used. For endogenous ROS detection, cells were treated with 5 μM DCFH-DA for 30 min. For exogenous H_2O_2 challenge, cells were first treated with 100 μM H_2O_2 for 60 min, then with DCFH-DA for 30 min. Parental NIH3T3 cells and DJ-1 knockdown cells (D2) were included as controls.

negative_positive_control.negative_control_description: Parental NIH3T3 cells (no exogenous DJ-1) and DJ-1 knockdown cells (D2) showed high fluorescence under H_2O_2 challenge.
negative_positive_control.positive_control_description: Wild-type DJ-1-expressing cells showed low fluorescence (effective ROS clearance) in both assays.
